verdict.rationale: Make documents a REST API with resource-oriented URLs, an SDK, and some endpoints labeled 'open beta'. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version identifiers, versioning scheme, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The axis applies to an API-bearing SaaS platform, so the absence of evidence yields 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
